mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_stats (user_id, total_count, correct_count, wrong_count, last_recognize_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{totalCount}, #{correctCount}, #{wrongCount}, #{lastRecognizeAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_stats SET total_count = #{totalCount}, correct_count = #{correctCount}, wrong_count = #{wrongCount}, last_recognize_at = #{lastRecognizeAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_stats SET total_count = total_count + 1, last_recognize_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_stats SET correct_count = correct_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_stats SET wrong_count = wrong_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
